text: The government should raise taxes on the wealthy and guarantee universal public health care. These reforms are necessary to reduce inequality and ensure that everyone receives treatment regardless of income.

At Tuesday's hearing, a witness said, "The government should raise taxes on the wealthy and guarantee universal public health care. These reforms are necessary to reduce inequality and ensure that everyone receives treatment regardless of income." The committee took no vote. This report records the witness's statement and does not endorse it.
The government should cut taxes and reduce regulation so private businesses can compete freely. Private health insurance and individual choice are preferable to a government-run health care system.

At Tuesday's hearing, one witness called for higher taxes on the wealthy and universal public health care. Another called for lower taxes, less regulation and private health insurance. Each witness spoke for five minutes. The committee took no vote. This report records their positions without endorsing either.
